column4: kindergarten flu season: his cough turns into pneumonia and a hospital stay
the project gets cut in the Q2 reorg and the whole team goes with it
the thyroid nodule (TI-RADS 3) has already turned malignant
the April pullback margin-calls the position
same cough again — pneumonia this time for sure
the key client churns at renewal and my Q3 number is dead
third cough of the year, the doctor hears wheezing
Q3 restructuring: my name is on the list this time
they will need a big sum someday and nobody has a plan
new semester, flu round two, back in the hospital ward
